uart.signal: The committed NUCLEO-H533RE firmware boots on the STM32H533RE profile, writes NUCLEO_H533RE_OK through USART2, and toggles PA5/LD2; the differential asserts identical UART output and execution snapshots in walk and scheduler modes.
uart.lane: pr-scheduler-observable (core-ci): cargo test -p labwired-core --features event-scheduler --test stm32h563_walk_differential
